# Smartech Online

> Industrial equipment supplier specializing in silicone membranes, vacuum bagging systems, thermal insulation, and custom ceramic components for manufacturing across woodworking, composites, solar, glass lamination, and specialty printing applications.

Smartech International represents Steinbach AG, a Germany-based manufacturer of industrial solutions. The site serves as a comprehensive product catalog for reusable silicone membranes, vacuum bagging equipment, thermal and acoustic insulation products, and advanced 3D-printed ceramic components used across diverse manufacturing sectors.

## Key Topics

- Silicone Membranes
- Vacuum Bagging
- Rubber Membranes
- Glass Lamination
- Composite Manufacturing
- Solar Lamination
- Thermal & Acoustic Insulation
- Reusable Vacuum Bags
- Woodworking
- Dye Sublimation
- Heat-Resistant Materials
- 3D Printed Ceramics
- PTFE Coated Products
- Durometer Specifications
- Steinbach AG

## Silicone & Rubber Membranes

- [Silicone and Rubber Vacuum Press Membranes](https://smartechonline.com/products/silicone-rubber-membranes): Silicone and rubber membranes for woodworking, composites, solar, and glass lamination applications.
- [Silicone & Rubber Membranes for Woodworking](https://smartechonline.com/products/silicone-rubber-membranes/woodworking): Silicone rubber membranes for woodworking vacuum press and 3D lamination applications.
- [Silicone & Rubber Membranes for Composites](https://smartechonline.com/products/silicone-rubber-membranes/composites): Silicone rubber membranes for composite manufacturing, vacuum bagging, and resin infusion.
- [Silicone & Rubber Membranes for Solar Lamination](https://smartechonline.com/products/silicone-rubber-membranes/solar): Silicone membranes for solar panel lamination with EVA encapsulant compatibility.
- [Silicone & Rubber Membranes for Glass Lamination](https://smartechonline.com/products/silicone-rubber-membranes/glass-lamination): High-quality silicone membranes for precision glass lamination and vacuum applications.
- [Silicone & Rubber Membranes for Dye Sublimation](https://smartechonline.com/products/silicone-rubber-membranes/dye-sublimation): Translucent silicone membranes for dye sublimation printing with heat resistance.
- [Silicone & Rubber Membranes for Steel Rule Dye](https://smartechonline.com/products/silicone-rubber-membranes/steel-rule-dye): Natural rubber membranes for steel rule die cutting and vacuum press applications.

## Reusable Vacuum Bagging Systems

- [Reusable Silicone Vacuum Bags](https://smartechonline.com/products/reusable-vacuum-bagging): Customizable reusable silicone vacuum bags for production with durometer and valve options.
- [Reusable Vacuum Bagging for Composites](https://smartechonline.com/products/reusable-vacuum-bagging/composites): Reusable vacuum bags for aerospace, automotive, and marine composite manufacturing.
- [Reusable Silicone Vacuum Bags for Glass Lamination](https://smartechonline.com/products/reusable-vacuum-bagging/glass-lamination): Reusable silicone vacuum bags for glass lamination with heat-resistant materials.
- [Reusable Silicone Vacuum Bags for Solar Lamination](https://smartechonline.com/products/reusable-vacuum-bagging/solar): Reusable vacuum bags for solar panel manufacturing and perovskite solar cell production.
- [Reusable Silicone Vacuum Bags for Dye Sublimation](https://smartechonline.com/products/reusable-vacuum-bagging/dye-sublimation): Heat-resistant reusable silicone vacuum bags for dye sublimation printing processes.
- [Reusable Silicone Vacuum Bags for Woodworking](https://smartechonline.com/products/reusable-vacuum-bagging/woodworking): Durable reusable silicone vacuum bags for woodworking projects and manufacturing.

## Thermal & Acoustic Insulation

- [Thermal & Acoustic Insulation Products](https://smartechonline.com/products/insulation): Smartech insulation solutions for construction, automotive, and industrial applications.
- [Automotive & Industrial Equipment Insulation](https://smartechonline.com/products/insulation/industrial-automotive): Industrial insulation products including fiberglass, mineral wool, and calcium silicate.
- [HVAC Insulation Products](https://smartechonline.com/products/insulation/hvac): HVAC insulation with thermal control and acoustic dampening for commercial spaces.

## Advanced Ceramic Components

- [Custom 3D Printed Ceramic Components](https://smartechonline.com/products/3d-printed-ceramic-components): Custom 3D-printed ceramic components using LCM technology for industrial applications.
